lines.beaver: 민호 씨, 어제 왜 연락이 안 됐어요? 걱정했어요.
lines.beaver_en: Minho, why couldn't I reach you yesterday? I was worried.
lines.beaver_roman: Minho ssi, eoje wae yeollagi an dwaesseoyo? geokjeonghaesseoyo.
lines.en: Sorry. My phone turned on, and then it died right away.

lines.beaver: 왜요? 제가 전화를 열 번이나 했어요.
lines.beaver_en: Why? I called you ten times.
lines.beaver_roman: Waeyo? jega jeonhwareul yeol beonina haesseoyo.
lines.en: The battery was dead. Even though I charged it, it didn't turn on.

lines.beaver_en: I see. Did you see my text?
lines.learner: 아니요, 문자도 이메일도 오늘 아침에 봤어요.
lines.en: No, I saw both the text and the email this morning.
lines.roman: Aniyo, munjado imeildo oneul achime bwasseoyo.

lines.beaver: 집 전화도 했는데 아무도 안 받았어요.
lines.beaver_en: I called your home phone too, but nobody answered.
lines.beaver_roman: Jip jeonhwado haenneunde amudo an badasseoyo.
lines.en: I was sleeping, so I didn't hear the phone ring.

lines.beaver_en: You must have been really tired.
lines.learner: 네, 피곤했는데도 일이 많아서 늦게 잤어요.
lines.en: Yes, even though I was tired, I had a lot of work, so I slept late.
lines.roman: Ne, pigonhaenneundedo iri manaseo neutge jasseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: By the way, did you get the company mail?
lines.en: Yes, I got it this morning.

lines.beaver: 중요한 서류예요. 받는 사람이 누구로 돼 있어요?
lines.beaver_en: It's an important document. Who is it addressed to?
lines.beaver_roman: Jungyohan seoryuyeyo. banneun sarami nuguro dwae isseoyo?
lines.en: The envelope says 'To Mr. Kim Minho.'

lines.beaver_en: That's right. Have you opened it already?
lines.en: I opened it earlier, but I was busy, so I put it back.

lines.beaver: 다음엔 연락이 안 되면 이메일이라도 보내 주세요.
lines.beaver_en: Next time, if I can't reach you, at least send an email.
lines.beaver_roman: Daeumen yeollagi an doemyeon imeirirado bonae juseyo.
lines.learner: 네, 다음에는 꼭 문자나 이메일을 보낼게요.
lines.en: Yes, next time I'll definitely send a text or an email.
lines.roman: Ne, daeumeneun kkok munjana imeireul bonaelgeyo.

lines.en: Thanks. I'll buy a new battery today, too.
